svg.text: Centralized Inspection with AWS Network Firewall & Transit Gateway
Key Traffic Flows (Illustrative - Routed via TGW & Inspection VPC):
a. App VPC A → TGW → Inspection VPC (NFW) → TGW → App VPC B (Inter-VPC)
b. App VPC A → TGW → Inspection VPC (NFW) → TGW → External (Outbound)
c. External → TGW → Inspection VPC (NFW) → TGW → App VPC A (Inbound)
